facts.fact: Pollicy says a proposed Law on Access to Information introduced by Senator Moise Nyarugabo remains pending approval by Parliament in the DRC.
facts.system: Proposed Law on Access to Information

facts.fact: Pollicy says Kenya's Access to Information Act of 2016 sets the process for requesting and handling information applications.
Pollicy says Morocco's Law No. 31-13 on the right to access information came into full effect in 2020.
Pollicy says Nigeria's Freedom of Information Act, enacted in 2011, grants citizens access to public records.
Pollicy says South Africa has the Promotion of Access to Information Act 2 of 2000, which requires public and private entities to disclose information on request.
Pollicy says South Africa established the Information Regulator to oversee, promote and enforce compliance with the Act.

facts.fact: Pollicy says the DRC open data portal, supported by the AfDB's Open Data for Africa with contributions from the National Statistics Institute, has not been updated recently.
Pollicy says the Kenya Open Data Initiative portal, supported by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics, gives free access to government data in machine-readable formats.
Pollicy says Morocco's data.gov.ma portal, managed by the Digital Development Agency, provides access to public sector data.
Pollicy says the Nigeria Data Portal, managed by the National Bureau of Statistics, offers data on health, agriculture, education, trade and investment.
Pollicy says South Africa's National Data Portal (data.gov.za), led by the Department of Public Service and Administration, is a government open data portal.
